# Boiling Point of Water at Sea Level

At **sea level** (standard atmospheric pressure of 101.325 kPa or 1 atm), water boils at:

## **100°C** (212°F)

This is the temperature at which the vapor pressure of water equals the surrounding atmospheric pressure, allowing bubbles of steam to form within the liquid and rise to the surface.
